# 2.21.3

Documentation and tooling only; no code, export or signature changes.

- Add `test:doc-links` (in `npm test`): every relative link and heading anchor in shipped markdown
  must resolve. The ten-version window in `doc/changes/` had silently broken two links to the pruned
  2.16.0 file; their facts (NoInfer needs TypeScript 5.4+, receipt repeat windows) are now inline,
  pointing at `SCALE-SAFETY.md`.
- Brief cheat sheet reads as a map again: an entrypoint table (including which subpaths load
  express/axios/socket.io at runtime; the narrow ones load no npm dependencies), and release-note
  paragraphs moved from the head/tail into their sections. Rental benchmark details live only in the
  rental README.
- `demo:build` / `demo:build:debug` copy the page with Node instead of `cmd` `copy /Y`, so they run
  in POSIX shells too.
